display_long_description:
# 🏡 Create Your Own Nook
Transform your room into a magical sanctuary! 
-
Little Nook is a mixed-reality decorating game where you build a cozy haven and watch adorable Frumis come to life right in your space.
[media]

# 🪴 Frumi Garden
Harvest magical fruits, water them with care, and watch adorable new Frumis sprout to life.
[media]

# 🥑 Invite Frumis -Nook Villagers-
Meet the Frumis, the lovable residents of your nook! Watch them wander around, react to your room, and playfully interact with furniture.
[media]

# 🏆 Complete Frumis’ Favors
Help your Frumis with their little favors to earn rewarding Gems, and upgrade your nook.
[media]

# 📖 Fill Up Your Collection Book
Discover new Frumis, stylish accessories, and fancy items to complete your very own collection book.
[media]

# 🪑 600+ Objects
Unleash your creativity with 600+ items across 6 themes! Build walls, platforms, and place furniture freely to design your ultimate dream space.
[media]
